title: Operations Coordinator
mission: Keep daily work moving by scheduling, tracking and fixing small problems before they grow.
outcomes_90_days: Run the weekly schedule and job tracker so every job has an owner, date and status.
Reduce late or missed jobs by setting up reminders and a simple checklist.
Document the five most repeated tasks as short step by step guides.
Report the top three delays every week with a suggested fix.

work_sample.title: Fix a messy week
work_sample.brief: You get a fictional week's job list (12 jobs, 3 crews, 2 conflicts, 1 missing parts order) in a spreadsheet. Produce a clean schedule, list the conflicts and your fix for each, and write the message you would send to one customer whose job moves.
work_sample.how_to_score: Score conflicts found, sensible fixes, a clean readable schedule, a short and honest customer message, and any questions raised about missing information.

interview_questions.question: Describe how you keep track of everything you are responsible for in one week.
weak_answer_signs: Cannot explain what happens when they are away

interview_questions.question: Tell me about a day when your plan fell apart. What did you do first?
good_answer_signs: Informed people quickly and set a new plan
Learned something and changed the process
weak_answer_signs: Waited for someone to tell them

interview_questions.question: How do you catch your own mistakes before others see them?
good_answer_signs: Uses a second look or checklist
Gives an example of a catch
weak_answer_signs: Says they do not make mistakes

red_flags: Cannot give a single example with dates or numbers
Careless spelling of names or addresses in the application
sourcing_channels: Admin and dispatch workers in similar trades
pay_research_hint: Look at several current postings for coordinator or dispatcher roles in your area and a published pay survey for your country. Note whether the hours include early or late shifts.
automation_note: AI and scheduling software can propose schedules, send reminders and fill spreadsheets. A person still decides trade offs, talks to customers and handles surprises.
